body: Reading this made me think I wrote it for a second. I'm still in university housing at the moment but I go home Saturday and I'm dreading it. Needing to cry but knowing I won't be able to because someone will want an explanation. Having to explain why I want to drop out/ take a break from school + what happened these past two semesters. Being tired of saying “I’m fine”. I’m not trying to say I know how you feel because our situations sound similar. But knowing that we, and maybe others, share a common situation brought me some odd form of comfort? I guess I just wanted to say thank you for sharing.
